source_text: Qur vero crediti quidem sunt a multis esse presbyteri, serviunt autem suis voluptatibus, et non preeponunt timorem Dei in cordibus suis, sed contumeliis agunt reliquos, et principalis leonsessionis tumore elati sunt, et in absconsis agunt mala, et dicunt, Nemo nos videt, redarguentur a Verbo; qui non secundum judicat, neque faciem attendit, sed in cor: et audient eas sunt a Daniele propheta voces: Semen Chanaan et non Juda, species seduwit te, et concupiscentia evertit cor tuum: inveterate dierum malorum, nunc advenerunt peccata tua que faciebas antea, judicans judicia injusta: et innocentes quidem damnabas, dimittebas vero nocentes, dicente Domino: Innocentem et justum non occides. De quibus dixit et Dominus: Si autem dixerit malus serous in corde suo, Tardat Dominus meus, et incipiat cadere servos et ancillas, et manducare et bibere et inebriari; Dominus servi illius in die qua nescit, et hora qua non sperat, et dividet eum, et partem ejus cum infidelibus ponet.
pass_a_gloss: For indeed they are believed by many to be presbyters, but they serve their own desires, and they do not put the fear of God in their hearts, but they treat the rest with contempt, and being puffed up with the pride of preeminence, and they do evil in secret, and they say, No one sees us, they will be convicted by the Word; who does not judge according to appearance, nor pay attention to face, but in heart: and you will hear these voices from the prophet Daniel: Seed of Canaan and not of Judah, desire has deceived you, and lust has overturned your heart: old man of evil days, now your sins which you did before have come, judging unjust judgments: and you were condemning the innocent, but you were acquitting the guilty, the Lord saying: You shall not kill the innocent and the just. About whom the Lord said: But if the evil servant says in his heart, My Lord delays, and begins to beat the servants and maids, and to eat and drink and get drunk; the Lord of that servant will come on the day when he does not know, and in the hour when he does not expect, and will cut him off, and will put his portion with the faithless.

choices.english: to eat and drink and get drunk
rejected: to eat and drink with drunkards and get drunk

pass_b_english: Many believe these men to be presbyters, yet they serve their own desires and have not set the fear of God in their hearts. Instead they treat everyone else with contempt, puffed up with the pride of preeminence, and they do evil in secret while saying, "No one sees us." The Word will convict them, for he does not judge by outward appearance or show partiality, but looks on the heart. You will hear these voices from the prophet Daniel: "Seed of Canaan and not of Judah, desire has deceived you, and lust has overturned your heart. Old man of evil days, now your sins which you committed before have come upon you — judging unjust judgments, condemning the innocent, and acquitting the guilty — while the Lord says, 'You shall not kill the innocent and the just.'" Concerning such men the Lord also said: "But if that evil servant says in his heart, 'My master is delayed,' and begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk, the master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not know, and will cut him in pieces and assign his portion with the faithless."

review.notes: The translation accurately captures the Latin text. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. Scripture references to Daniel are correctly identified in the text. The distinction between 'Dominus' as Lord (God) and 'Dominus' as master (of the servant) is maintained in Pass B. All clauses, including the specific descriptions of the false presbyters and the prophetic warnings, are present.
